Choice.description: A choice standing in for an item or value, anywhere one goes

Chosen.description: A read of a pick, standing in any field: `value` reads a named value from the picked entity's `values` instead of the pick itself (the damage type of the chosen dragon); `from` is the entity the choice is on, when not this one

anyOf.description: Fixed dice, such as 2d8, 1d6+1, or d4
Computed dice: Sneak Attack, upcasting
A value that steps up at the listed levels (class level with `of`, otherwise character level)
A table's column at a level: `by`, or the level in the class the rule came from. The table is an id, or a path to a field that holds one: "spellcasting.{at}.slots"
The level the spell was cast at
A named value from an entity's `values` (default: the entity the rule is on)
The level of a stacking state, such as exhaustion

The total on the units of this pool that this use's cost spent: their kept numbers in a `rolled` pool, or a roll of their dice (Hit Dice). `pool` can name a group. A fact of the moment, not a field, like an event's
How many creatures or objects the who picks right now: "the number of allies you can see within 30 feet"
A field of the triggering event, or of the event a `when` tests

What the creature's rules add to a roll with these fields, as an event test's `match` names them: {bonus: {roll: "roll:check", skill: "skill:perception"}} is its Wisdom (Perception) bonus. A skill with no ability named uses its own; a field in braces is a pick or the key a `$at` is at
One number or another, by a test: "1d12 if the target is missing any of its hit points, otherwise 1d8". The test reads the creature an outcome's `when` reads, the recipient

In an `emits` entry, a fact the engine settles as it runs what the entry covers: the d20's face, the total, whether it succeeded and whether it was a critical hit, what the attack is made with, what was spent, the spell and slot level, the damage dealt, the damage left over once hit points reach 0, the hit points it leaves (design/model/triggers-and-events.md, "Where events come from")
In an `emits` entry, a stored field of what the entry covers, by its path: "action", "damage.type"
What an earlier outcome (by key) rolled or dealt; for a `pool` outcome that spends Hit Dice or `rolled` units, the total rolled on them
The speed being moved with, whichever it is: a fact of the moment, not a field
A field read by its path: "target.hp.max"; with no role, the creature in question

Fields of the thing tested. In a filter, the candidate's: {match: {school: "spell-school:evocation", level: 0}}; elsewhere, the creature in question's, as a path with no role reads: "a Large or smaller beast" is {match: {creatureType: "creature-type:beast", size: {atMost: "size:large"}}}. A value equals the field, or is in it when the field is a list; a list of values is any of them; an object matches a nested field the same way; {atLeast, atMost} compares a number, or a ranked id such as a size by its rank; a bound {of: role, steps?} is that creature's own value of the field, `steps` ranks away ("larger than you" is {atLeast: {of: "self", steps: 1}}); `true` matches any field that is set; {chosen} and {choose} stand for a pick. The fields are checked against the kind's schema, a creature's outside a filter
Has a level in this class, or has this subclass. A level threshold is a `compare`: {compare: "levels.class:cleric", atLeast: 3}
The name of a named option: "Potent Spellcasting"

Has a feature, feat, spell known, item, background, species, state, or condition (a subspecies counts as its parent, and a species as any it `countsAs`). A group id: has anything in that group, as "a Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature". `chosen`: with these picks made in its choices, by key: Draconic Ancestry with the red dragon picked. `match`: for an item, how it is carried, by the fields a saved character keeps on the item (`worn`, `held`, `attuned`): wearing armor is {has: "group:armor", match: {worn: true}}, attuned to and holding this item {has: "this", match: {attuned: true, held: true}}; with no `match`, carrying it at all. `source`: for a state, the role that applied it: "a creature grappled by you" is {has: "condition:grappled", source: "self"}. In a choice filter, `candidate` is the option being considered.
A state whose effects lower one of these fields: a long rest ends {kind: state, where: {lowers: ["hp.max"]}}, the states reducing your hit point maximum
In a choice filter: the option is in this group, such as every Eldritch Invocation, a Fighting Style feat, or a gaming set; with `for`, only those available to that class

The candidate, or the spell being cast, is something you have because this entity gave it: "one spell you gained from this feature". A class id means any feature that class or its subclasses gave you, or a spell that counts as that class's: "your Wizard spells" is {grantedBy: "class:wizard"}
Can cast at least one spell: "requires attunement by a spellcaster"
Is under this restriction: "can't speak"
Has this defense once all its sources combine: "a creature that can't be blinded" is {defense: {immune: "condition:blinded"}}

What a Value reads equals this (a field that holds a flag or an id: "a weapon you have mastered" is {compare: "masteries.{attack.item}", equals: true}), or a number it reads is at least or at most another: "Cleric level 3 or higher" is {compare: "levels.class:cleric", atLeast: 3}; "Strength 13 or higher" is {compare: "abilities.ability:str", atLeast: 13}; "while the item has at least 1 charge" is {compare: "this.pools.charges.current", atLeast: 1}; "half its hit points or fewer" is {compare: "hp.current", atMost: {times: "hp.max", by: 0.5}}. A path with no role reads the creature the test is about

The event's own fields, which its vocabulary entry declares in `payload`, read as in a filter's `match`: {"roll": "roll:attack", "natural": 20, "attack": {"item": "this"}} on event:roll-resolved, {"rest": "rest:long"} on event:rest-finished, {"state": "condition:prone"} on event:state-applied, {"class": "class:fighter"} or {"gives": {"picks": "maneuvers"}} on event:level-gained, {"item": "this"} on an item event, {"count": 20} on event:initiative-count. An id matches either edition and anything that isA it, a group matches its members, and `this` is the entity the rule is on

This event is being handled, or something that happens because of it, with these fields: "an attack roll with this weapon" is {event: "event:roll-made", by: "self", match: {roll: "roll:attack", attack: {item: "this"}}}. The same shape as a trigger; no `by` means anyone
Within this many feet of a role, or of any member of a pool
Is this role, or (in a choice filter) the option being considered is this id or what was picked for that choice: a second language that isn't the first
It is this role's turn: "on your turn"
Evaluates creature atoms against another role
The activity being used is this one, or matches the filter: "a spell that calls for a saving throw" is {kind: activity, where: {match: {delivery: {save: true}}}}
The spell being cast is one of these, or matches a filter: "an evocation spell" is {kind: spell, where: {match: {school: "spell-school:evocation"}}}. On a state, the spell it came from
A spell the caster has prepared
In a filter, the candidate is held in this pool: "a spell in your spellbook" is {kind: spell, where: {stored: "spellbook"}}
Has at least this cover against a role
On the ground, as opposed to flying, climbing, or swimming
"moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit"

An id matches either edition and anything that isA it, a group matches its members, and `this` is the entity the rule is on

Fires when its test turns true for the creature in `subject` (self if omitted), as a number crosses a line: "when you drop to 0 hit points" is {becomes: {compare: {hp: "current"}, atMost: 0}}
A set time after a use spends the pool: "can't be used again until 3 days have passed" is {after: {amount: 3, unit: "day"}, amount: "all"}
Advantage or disadvantage on the rolls `when` names with an event:roll-made test

The roll succeeds or fails, or is or isn't a critical hit, whatever the die says: Paralyzed's Str and Dex saves fail (success: false) and its hits from within 5 feet are critical (crit: true); Adamantine Armor's critical hits become normal hits (crit: false)
Extra damage of its own type: "an extra 1d6 fire damage". A bonus to the damage roll itself is a modifier on `roll`
Changes to the spell when cast this way, in the patch grammar: {"activities": {"cast": {"concentration": {"$delete": true}}}}
Spells added to a spell list for you: an Otherworldly Patron's expanded list, a dragonmark's spells
Fixed dice, such as 2d8, 1d6+1, or d4
Any entity of this kind that matches `where`

What changes: an entity, `this`, or every entity or activity a filter picks (illusion spells, medium armor); `event`, the event the `when` tests, as {event} reads it (a roll's `total`, each `die`, its `criticalMinimum`). Without `of`, the creature the effect applies to

Changes fields of what `of` picks, in the patch grammar, as its paths read them. A creature's: {"set": {"ac": {"$add": 1}}}, {"set": {"abilities": {"ability:str": {"$atLeast": 19}}}}, every speed {"set": {"speeds": {"$where": true, "speed": {"$multiply": 0.5}}}}; changes to one number combine as bonuses stack, and a set value wins. A roll's: {"of": "event", "set": {"total": {"$add": "modifiers.ability:cha"}}} with a `when` naming the roll. An entity's: {"of": {"kind": "activity", "where": {"spell": "spell:guidance"}}, "set": {"range": {"$replace": {"distance": 60}}}}, checked against the kind's schema; a creature's fields aren't, as a rule may compute a new one
Damage that counts as having this qualifier, against resistance and immunity: a monk's unarmed strikes count as magical
`target` limits the restriction to acting against someone: "can't attack the charmer"

Lifts a restriction other rules impose: a druid in Wild Shape can still cast spells. Doing without a spell's component is a `change` of the spell; doing what a rule forbids anyway is `suppress` of that rule's effect

Antimagic suppresses magic; Alert suppresses the unseen-attacker rule against you. With `effects`, only the effects of those rules or states with these keys: a feat that frees you from somatic components has {"rule": ["rule:components"], "effects": ["somatic"]}
How a creature perceives: darkvision, blindsight, truesight, See Invisibility, Devil's Sight
A label that isn't an entity: "Spring"
Keeps a pick that no rule reads (yet) and shows it: a god, an eladrin's season, a homebrew flavor choice. Rules can still read it with {chosen}
More targets, with their own conditions: "a second creature within 10 feet of the first target"
A save; `kind` names a save tied to no ability: roll:death-save

A starting value for a number that nothing stores: the proficiency bonus by level, 10 + Dexterity modifier as AC, 13 + Dexterity modifier under Mage Armor. Where several apply, or a value is stored too, the highest is the start, and every other operator works on it
Adds to a number, or to a time span: a ritual takes 10 minutes longer. With `upTo`, not past that number. A missing field counts as 0
Raises the number to at least this: "you can attack twice, instead of once"
Lowers the number to at most this
A pattern, read as in `match`: the list elements whose fields match it
Removes the list elements that match: a ritual expends no spell slot

Edits the elements of a list, or the entries of a map, that match `$where` (`true`: every one) with the other fields or an operator: {"$where": {"resource": "action"}, "resource": "bonus-action"}; every speed {"$where": true, "speed": {"$multiply": 0.5}}
Any entity of this kind that matches `where`
Edits the map entry at this key, which may be a pick: "+1 to an ability of your choice" is {"abilities": {"$at": {"choose": …}, "$add": 1}}

id.description: A uuid, not a content id

bundles.description: The content it is built with

rules.description: Optional rules turned on, each with what it tracks, in the shape its rule entity declares

hp.description: The hit points this level's Hit Die gave: its maximum at the first level, afterwards the number rolled or the fixed value

items.description: One level in a class, with the picks made there

classes.description: Each class's levels in order, the first entry its level 1. The engine works out the count per class and in all (`levels.class:wizard`, `levels.total`)

hp.description: Hit points left. A higher maximum doesn't heal; a lower one caps them

state.description: An id of kind state or condition

items.description: A state or condition on the character, with picks made when it was applied (Protection from Energy's damage type)

companions.description: The ids of companions saved beside it: a familiar, a summoned creature, a mount

Character.description: A character, as saved: what the player decided and what has happened in play

holds.description: What each of its pools holds, by the pool's key: the spells in a spellbook, the spells stored in a Ring of Spell Storing. An entry with an `amount` takes up that much of the pool (the slot level a stored spell was cast with)

InventoryEntry.description: An item carried: its own picks and spent charges, what its pools hold, and what is inside it

Picks.description: Picks by the id of the entity offering the choice, then the choice's key

Spent.description: Units spent from each pool, by its key. What is left is worked out: the maximum minus this

anyOf.description: Computed dice: Sneak Attack, upcasting
A value that steps up at the listed levels (class level with `of`, otherwise character level)
A table's column at a level: `by`, or the level in the class the rule came from. The table is an id, or a path to a field that holds one: "spellcasting.{at}.slots"
The level the spell was cast at
A named value from an entity's `values` (default: the entity the rule is on)
The level of a stacking state, such as exhaustion

The total on the units of this pool that this use's cost spent: their kept numbers in a `rolled` pool, or a roll of their dice (Hit Dice). `pool` can name a group. A fact of the moment, not a field, like an event's
How many creatures or objects the who picks right now: "the number of allies you can see within 30 feet"
A field of the triggering event, or of the event a `when` tests

What the creature's rules add to a roll with these fields, as an event test's `match` names them: {bonus: {roll: "roll:check", skill: "skill:perception"}} is its Wisdom (Perception) bonus. A skill with no ability named uses its own; a field in braces is a pick or the key a `$at` is at
One number or another, by a test: "1d12 if the target is missing any of its hit points, otherwise 1d8". The test reads the creature an outcome's `when` reads, the recipient

In an `emits` entry, a fact the engine settles as it runs what the entry covers: the d20's face, the total, whether it succeeded and whether it was a critical hit, what the attack is made with, what was spent, the spell and slot level, the damage dealt, the damage left over once hit points reach 0, the hit points it leaves (design/model/triggers-and-events.md, "Where events come from")
In an `emits` entry, a stored field of what the entry covers, by its path: "action", "damage.type"
What an earlier outcome (by key) rolled or dealt; for a `pool` outcome that spends Hit Dice or `rolled` units, the total rolled on them
The speed being moved with, whichever it is: a fact of the moment, not a field
A number worked out in play: a path such as "levels.total" or "modifiers.ability:wis", or arithmetic on them
